comparable_cases.why_comparable: Formula retail limited-restaurant (Yi Fang Taiwan Fruit Tea) approved 83 meters away at 645 Irving St in the same NCD-Inner Sunset district. Required a Conditional Use Authorization hearing for the formula retail component.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Formula retail restaurant required a CUA and took 279 days from filing to approval, but was approved with only standard eating-and-drinking conditions (sidewalk maintenance, noise, odor, trash, community liaison). No special restrictions on formula retail restaurants in this district.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Immediately adjacent at 731 Irving St (10 meters), same block, same NCD-Inner Sunset zoning. Restaurant continuation approved without conditions.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Restaurant use approved next door as continuation of existing use (Villa Romana to Lale), confirming the corridor's established restaurant character and that continuation approvals are routine in this location.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Multi-location chain restaurant (Pluto's, 7 locations) approved at 627 Irving St, 106 meters away in NCD-Inner Sunset. Agency referral for ABC Type 41 with explicit finding that Pluto's is not formula retail.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning found that a 7-location chain was not formula retail in the Inner Sunset NCD; Super Duper's 11 locations may trigger formula retail review, but the district allows formula retail restaurants without additional authorization beyond standard CUA process.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Non-formula restaurant at 627 Irving St (106 meters) approved for ABC Type 41, same NCD-Inner Sunset zoning, decided in 6 days as agency referral.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Agency referral approvals for restaurant use in this district are routine and fast (under one week), though these are continuations rather than new uses requiring hearings.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Restaurant ABC Type 41 referral at 1378 9th Ave (137 meters), NCD-Inner Sunset, approved in 5 days. Notes that formula retail is not permitted but restaurant use is per Planning Code Section 730.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Agency referral explicitly states formula retail not permitted, but this refers to over-the-counter approvals; formula retail restaurants still require CUA process as shown by the Yi Fang approval.

comparable_cases.why_comparable: Change of use from limited restaurant to full restaurant at 1239 9th Ave (167 meters) in NCD-Inner Sunset, approved via CUA in 78 days with no extracted conditions.
comparable_cases.key_takeaway: CUA for restaurant intensification (limited to full) approved within 3 months without special conditions, showing the Commission's receptiveness to restaurant uses on this corridor.

comparable_cases.key_takeaway: Planning Code Section 178(b) continuation-of-use provisions are routinely invoked in this district for spaces with prior restaurant history, potentially applicable to 737 Irving given its continuous restaurant use since at least 2003.

filing_playbook.action: After DPH plan approval and building permit issuance, complete construction and schedule the DPH pre-opening inspection and the DBI final inspection.
filing_playbook.what_to_say: Book the DPH pre-opening inspection at least two weeks in advance with the assigned plan reviewer. The inspector will verify that the built space matches the approved plans. After DPH approval, schedule the DBI final and the Fire Department final (if required), then apply for the Health Permit to Operate. The permit is issued after all inspections pass and the $470 application fee is paid.

timeline_cost.notes: The timeline and cost assume a Conditional Use Authorization is required for formula retail and is approved. CUA filing to Commission approval: 120 to 300 days, as shown by the Yi Fang formula retail restaurant CUA at 645 Irving St which took 279 days from filing (3 May 2019) to approval (6 February 2020). The range reflects variation in hearing scheduling, environmental review (categorical exemption expected), and whether discretionary review or an appeal is filed. The CUA application fee was $2,747 on the 2023-24 schedule and is CPI-adjusted annually (roughly $3,100 now for a no-construction CUA; fees rise with construction cost). Building permit fees ($800 to $15,000) and DPH plan check ($828 to $2,207) are additional and depend on construction valuation and TI scope. If formula retail does not apply, the over-the-counter building permit and health permit path takes 14 to 120 days at lower cost. This timeline is to approval of the CUA and issuance of permits, not to opening; construction, final inspections and permit-to-operate issuance add 2 to 4 months after permit issuance.

status_definitions.allowed: Allowed: the cited records or code sections show this approval is available as of right, or already exists for this space, without a discretionary hearing.
status_definitions.further_review: Further review: the approval is obtainable only through a discretionary or multi-step review (a hearing, a referral, a licence investigation) whose result the records do not settle.
status_definitions.potential_blocker: Potential blocker: a cited rule, cap or record could stop this approval or force a change to the concept unless a specific condition is met.
status_definitions.not_permitted: Not permitted: a cited code section prohibits this use or approval at this address as the concept is described.
status_definitions.insufficient_information: Insufficient information: the records in hand do not show whether this approval is needed or obtainable; the could-not-establish section says what would settle it.

confidence_definitions.verified: Verified: stated directly by a cited record or code section that applies to this exact address, parcel or zoning district.
confidence_definitions.likely_applicable: Likely applicable: inferred from cited records of comparable cases or from a general rule; not stated for this address.
confidence_definitions.needs_confirmation: Needs confirmation: plausible but not supported by a record in hand; confirm with the agency or document named.
confidence_definitions.professional_review_required: Professional review required: depends on plans, an inspection, or legal or design judgment that public records cannot supply.

records_summary: The records show 737 Irving St has operated as a restaurant continuously since at least 2003. The site history includes six Planning Department approvals between 2003-2020, all for restaurant use including multiple ABC Type 47 (full bar) licenses and a 2020 limited restaurant approval. A restaurant use is principally permitted in the NCD-Inner Sunset zoning district on the first story (Planning Code § 730). The block is extremely dense with 43 registered food and drink businesses within 500 feet, including 4 bars and 19 active ABC on-sale licenses within that radius. The Inner Sunset has seen very light use-decision activity over the past 5 years—only 5 dated decisions within 1,000 feet, too few to establish an approval rate, though 2 were approved outright and 3 approved with conditions.
